summary: Verified new /api/admin surface + AdminConsole UI end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 new admin tests + 54/54 prior tests all green (76/76 total, 102s). Coverage: (1) Auth guards on 3 admin GETs — anon=401, creator=403, brand=403, admin=200. (2) GET /admin/creators/pending returns shape with user_id/name/email/instagram_handle/instagram_profile_url/niches/follower_count/base_rate/address; vetted/rejected excluded. (3) approve → vetting_status=vetted AND users.status=active (verified via /auth/me), idempotent (2nd approve → 200 vetted). reject → rejected. non-existent user → 404. (4) GET /admin/collaborations returns {by_state:{all 9 states present},total} with row shape (id, state, next_state, quoted_rate, campaign{...}, brand_name, creator{...}, payment). (5) Full state machine: applied→vetted→accepted→(422 no amount)→commercial_agreed(8500)→slot_booked→attended→content_submitted→(422 no fee)→in_payment(1500) creates payment(agreed_amount=8500, platform_fee=1500, creator_payout=8500, state=pending); mark_paid returns state=paid+paid_at+collaboration_id and closes collab; advancing from closed → 400 'already at the final state'. (6) Advance from in_payment WITHOUT mark_paid → closed but payment.state stays 'pending' (verified). (7) Metrics: shape {open_campaigns, vetted_creators, total_paid_out}; total_paid_out increases by exactly 2500 after a mark_paid. Frontend: Playwright happy-path validated — admin logs in and navigates via nav-admin to /admin, admin-console-page + admin-heading load; metrics tiles resolve from '—' to real numbers with rupee svg on paid-out; fresh test creator appears in admin-vetting-row-<uid> with admin-vetting-ig-<uid>; Approve removes the row and increments vetted_creators (4→5); fresh applied collab located by campaign title; two plain advances (applied→vetted→accepted); admin-advance-dialog opens for commercial_agreed with admin-advance-amount-input=8500 → dialog closes; three plain advances; admin-advance-dialog opens for in_payment with admin-advance-fee-input=1500 → dialog closes; admin-collab-mark-paid-<id> visible and clicking it moves the row into admin-collabs-group-closed and increments total_paid_out from 22,000 → 30,500 (Δ=8,500). Access control: unauth /admin → /login; creator /admin → /dashboard; creator navbar has no nav-admin.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1730+ lines — refactor into /app/backend/routers/*.py is severely overdue (flagged in iterations 6 & 7). Auth/creator/brand/campaigns/admin routers all live in one file, which will hurt maintainability now that the admin surface has landed.
AdminConsole.jsx is 739 lines with three sections + AdvanceDialog inline — consider splitting into components/admin/VettingQueue.jsx, CollaborationsBoard.jsx, MetricsStrip.jsx, AdvanceDialog.jsx.

GET /api/admin/creators/pending caps at 500 rows without pagination. The dev DB already has ~150 pending TEST_ creators; on prod this list will need pagination + filters (search by handle, sort by created_at).

STATE_META['in_payment'].tone uses Tailwind class 'bg-ember-500/15 text-ember-500 border-ember-500/30' — verify that Tailwind config actually defines an 'ember-500' color (some other tiles use ember-500, so likely OK, but this is the only pill using tokens beyond the standard palette).

AdvanceDialog pre-fills fee = round(agreed*0.15) which is a nice UX default but is silently discarded if the admin backspaces it and submits — the client-side validator accepts 0 which is technically valid but may be a data-entry bug. Consider warning if fee=0.

Advance from 'in_payment' via /advance quietly closes the collab while leaving payment.state='pending' — this is by design per the review request but is easy to trigger accidentally. Consider making the /advance button hidden or disabled once payment exists (only /mark_paid should be exposed) — currently the UI already flips to Mark-as-paid, but the backend still permits /advance from in_payment.

Frontend Login.jsx always redirects to /dashboard regardless of role. Admins have to click nav-admin to reach /admin. Consider role-aware default landing (admin → /admin, creator → /dashboard, brand → /dashboard). Not a blocker.
